visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise overlay on backgrounds to remove digital flatness. Keeps it organic and natural.
visual_enhancers.border: Use 1px borders using border-[#D5C8B7] to create elegant architectural lines. Avoid heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: Image zoom on hover (`scale-105` with `duration-700 ease-out`). Text color shifts subtly.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero image max overlay opacity: `bg-black/30`. Keep it light, preserve the photography.

layouts.general: Editorial style, left-aligned, asymmetrical, heavy negative space (`py-24`, `gap-16`). Never center-everything.
layouts.hero: Cinematic full height (100vh). Left-aligned huge typography with line-by-line mask reveal animation. Content anchored to bottom.
layouts.experiences: Bento Grid Mode A: Asymmetrical layout mixing square, tall, and wide photographic cards with deep negative space.
layouts.gallery: Masonry or irregular grid, mixing 3:4 and 16:9 aspect ratios. Implement filterable buttons and a lightbox.
layouts.about: Magazine style, two-column layouts where text and imagery overlap slightly to create depth.

motion.scroll: Use Lenis for premium momentum scroll.
motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion line-by-line staggered text reveal (opacity and y-axis translation).
motion.parallax: Subtle y-axis parallax on large images during scroll using framer-motion useScroll.
motion.marquee: Slow-moving editorial ribbon. Pale background (`#D5C8B7`), dark serif text. `gap-24`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lucide-react`, `framer-motion`, `react-fast-marquee`, and `lenis` (or `@studio-freight/lenis`) as they are required for premium web functionality.
Use react-router-dom to build the 5 specific pages (Home, Surf Lessons, About Us, Gallery, Contact) inside standard .js / .jsx files.
IMPORTANT: Write .js or .jsx files, DO NOT output .tsx files as this is a JavaScript project.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for structural marketing layouts. Avoid wrapping entire marketing pages in Shadcn standard 'Card' components.
Implement scroll animations with framer-motion (e.g., `whileInView`, `viewport={{ once: true }}`).
Gallery page must have a filter system (All, Action, Lessons, Lifestyle) and an image lightbox (a full-screen fixed div modal overlay upon click).
Contact page form should utilize HTML/Shadcn inputs and a submit handler that opens the floating WhatsApp link with prefilled details.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
Do not center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Use 2-3x more spacing (e.g. `py-24`, `p-12`) than feels comfortable.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use `lucide-react`.
NEVER use placeholder URLs. Use the exact image_urls provided in this JSON.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="book-now-btn"`).
Header must not have a fully transparent background. Use glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F7F5F0]/70`) so navigation links are readable over images.
Follow mobile-first responsive design strictly. Add responsive typography (`text-4xl md:text-6xl`).
Ensure `data-testid` is applied on all buttons, links, form inputs, and dynamic UI states.
